# Supplier Product References

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Supplier Product References tie **one supplier to one specific product variant** and control sourcing eligibility: supplier item identity, purchase UOM, currency and cost, MOQ, lead time, availability/preference and validity. Keep the reference active with a compatible purchase unit and selected currency before using **Purchase Needs**, PO lines or agreements.

Search for the supplier and SKU; review duplicates and validity dates. A currency mismatch or inactive reference should exclude that supplier from the dependent sourcing dropdown. Do not force an incompatible supplier into a PO or replace historic purchase-line quantity snapshots after sending.
